//: The centre cell of a STATION's crossarm - ropeway:drivestation and ropeway:tensionstation both want one here, and a plain ropeway:pylonbase now wants the plain sheave and nothing else. It is not on the mechanical network: no entityBehaviors, no MPConsumer, no resistance. What it does is TURN when the line runs; BEBullwheel + BullwheelRenderer draw shapes/block/bullwheelrim.json over the static shape below. It is no longer decoration that happens to spin, because the shape now carries the two bearing standards it stands in and the hub axle running out through them to the lay shaft next door - the wheel is visibly bolted to the crossarm and visibly joined to the thing that drives it.
